rec.name: PDP Shop the Look Bundle Section
rec.status: Design concept — Variant 3 selected (build/launch status not confirmed)

what.text: A 'Shop the Look' section placed below the PDP accordions (Description, Size guide, Delivery & Returns). It shows a large lifestyle image of models wearing a coordinated outfit, followed by a compact list of the individual products in that look (e.g. Basic Hoodie and Basic Jogger in Burgundy). Each row has a thumbnail, product name, price, a size dropdown and an add-to-cart button. Three layout variants were designed; Variant 3 is marked as the chosen one.

why.text: Showing products worn together as a complete outfit makes it easy for shoppers to picture the whole look. This inspires them to buy complementary items, which raises items per order and AOV. Letting shoppers choose a size and add straight from the PDP removes the clicks of visiting other product pages. The lifestyle image adds aspirational social context. The visible price and quick add keep friction low.

how.text: Build it as a theme section on the PDP, placed after the accordion block. Add a lifestyle image, with the linked products coming from a product list (probably a metafield or section blocks). For each product, render a row with thumbnail, title, price, a variant (size) select and an add-to-cart control. Variant 3 uses a round black '+' icon button for quick add, instead of the outlined cart icon used in Variants 1 and 2. The ticket does not describe how the add-to-cart is wired up or whether the items are added as a bundle or one by one.

items: Products in the look (2 in Variants 1 and 3; 4 in Variant 2 covering two colorways)
Add-to-cart control style (outlined cart icon vs. black round '+' button)
Number of products shown (2 vs. 4, i.e. one colorway vs. two)

dependencies.text: Needs a way to map a look image to its products (metafield or product-list setting), plus the variant data for size selectors. The ticket mentions a Figma file but gives no technical detail. Whether an app is used is not stated.

items: Items per order / units per transaction

images.caption: Three layout variants of the 'Shoppe den Look' section on mobile PDP; Variant 3 (black '+' quick-add button, 2 products) is checked as chosen. Variant 2 shows 4 products across two colorways.
Each row shows thumbnail, product name, price, size dropdown and an add control; Variant 3 uses a black circular '+' button.
